$schema.description: Optional URL or path of this JSON Schema, for editors.

title.description: Name of the jingle. Written to the audio file's tags and the MIDI file.

author.description: Who made the jingle (a person or company), written to the audio file's artist tag. Only fill it in when the user gives it; never guess.

copyright.description: Copyright notice, e.g. "© 2026 Example Inc.", written to the audio file's copyright tag and the MIDI copyright event. Only fill it in when the user gives it; never guess.

tempo.description: Beats per minute; one beat is a quarter note. 100–140 suits most jingles.

meter.description: Time signature for sheet music, e.g. "4/4", "3/4", "6/8" (default "4/4"). It does not change the sound: `at`, `len` and `tempo` still count quarter notes, so a 3/4 bar is 3 beats and a 6/8 bar is 3 beats too.

key.description: Key signature for sheet music: a major key ("C", "G", "F", "Bb", "D") or a minor one with "m" ("Am", "Em", "Dm", "F#m"); default "C". It does not change the sound or the pitches: still write each note's real pitch ("F#4" in G major).

pickup.description: Sheet music only: beats before the first full bar (an upbeat, as in Happy Birthday's "Hap-py" = 1 beat in 3/4). Bar lines then fall at pickup, pickup + one bar, and so on. Less than one bar.

seconds.description: Seconds from the start of the jingle.

anyOf.description: A time in seconds, for times the animation fixes ("lands at 1.5 s").

beats.description: Beats (quarter notes at `tempo`) from the start.

length.description: Total length of the audio. Leave room after the last note for it to ring out (and for a voice-over, if any).

seed.description: Seed for every random detail (mallet noise, reverb, humanize). Same score + seed = identical audio.

loudness.description: Target integrated loudness in LUFS. -14 matches YouTube; leave the default unless asked.

fadeOut.description: Seconds of fade at the very end.

limiter.description: Allow a few dB of transparent peak limiting so the jingle reaches the loudness target. Leave it on unless asked.

master.description: Mix settings for the whole jingle.

cues.description: Named moments, e.g. { "hit": { "seconds": 1.5 }, "voice": { "seconds": 1.8 } }. Notes can be placed on them and the timing map reports them.

seconds.description: Seconds from the start of the jingle.

anyOf.description: A time in seconds, for times the animation fixes ("lands at 1.5 s").

beats.description: Beats (quarter notes at `tempo`) from the start.

additionalProperties.description: A named moment the animation syncs to, e.g. { "seconds": 1.5 } for a hit. Give it in seconds when the animation fixes the time, so you never convert seconds to beats yourself. A cue needs no note on it (e.g. where a voice-over starts).

base.description: A built-in instrument or effect (e.g. "glockenspiel", "impact"), or another custom instrument of this score.

decay.description: How long it rings, as a multiple of the base's ring: 0.5 = half as long (damped), 2 = twice as long. Above 1 only for built-ins that have a block definition (listed by getInstrument).

brightness.description: Tone colour: -1 dark and muffled, 0 as is, 1 bright and crisp.

attack.description: Seconds to fade in at the start: 0.001 keeps the strike; 0.02–0.08 softens it; 0.2+ swells in.

params.description: Adjustments to the base sound. Leave out what should stay as it is.

variant.description: Always play this variant of the base (for bases with variants, e.g. impact "soft"/"hard").

transpose.description: Semitones to shift the pitch (12 = an octave up). Pitched bases only.

detune.description: Cents to detune by (a slight detune against another layer thickens the sound).

gain.description: Level in dB relative to the base (0 = as is, -6 = about half as loud).

description.description: One line for people: what this sounds like.

base.description: A built-in instrument or effect (e.g. "glockenspiel", "impact"), or another custom instrument of this score.

decay.description: How long it rings, as a multiple of the base's ring: 0.5 = half as long (damped), 2 = twice as long. Above 1 only for built-ins that have a block definition (listed by getInstrument).

brightness.description: Tone colour: -1 dark and muffled, 0 as is, 1 bright and crisp.

attack.description: Seconds to fade in at the start: 0.001 keeps the strike; 0.02–0.08 softens it; 0.2+ swells in.

params.description: Adjustments to the base sound. Leave out what should stay as it is.

variant.description: Always play this variant of the base (for bases with variants, e.g. impact "soft"/"hard").

transpose.description: Semitones to shift the pitch (12 = an octave up). Pitched bases only.

detune.description: Cents to detune by (a slight detune against another layer thickens the sound).

gain.description: Level in dB relative to the base (0 = as is, -6 = about half as loud).

delay.description: Seconds after the note's onset that this layer starts (an echo, a late sparkle). Default 0. A layer with a length (whoosh, riser) is shortened by its delay, so the stack still ends at the note's `len`.

items.description: One sound in a stack: a base with its own adjustments.

layers.description: 2–6 sounds played together on every note. On a chord, pitched layers play every pitch; layers without pitch (an impact, a clap) play once.

description.description: One line for people: what this sounds like.

anyOf.description: Several sounds played together on every note, e.g. a piano chord with a soft impact under it: { "layers": [ { "base": "grandpiano" }, { "base": "impact", "gain": -8 } ] }.

kind.description: "instrument" plays notes; "sfx" is a sound effect — `pitch` becomes optional (it uses `pitch` below when none is given).

pitch.description: For an "sfx" with pitched blocks: the pitch it plays when a note gives none (e.g. "D7" for a laser). Notes may give any pitch from C1 to C8.

length.description: For an "sfx": the sound lasts `len` (default this many seconds), like whoosh and riser, and may be placed by `end`. pitchEnv and envelopes without times then span the whole length.

osc.description: Waveform: sine (pure, soft), triangle (hollow, flute-like), saw (bright, brassy, buzzy), square (hollow, retro, clarinet-like), pulse (nasal; set `width`).

ratio.description: Frequency as a multiple of the note's (1 = the note, 2 = an octave up, 0.5 = an octave down, 3 = a fifth above the octave).

detune.description: Cents (two saws at -7 and +7 make a thick, chorused sound).

width.description: Pulse width for `pulse` (0.5 = square, 0.1 = thin and nasal).

level.description: Level 0–1, relative to the other blocks.

env.description: This oscillator's own envelope; without it the oscillator follows the whole sound's `env`.

attack.description: Seconds to rise to full level (0.001–0.005 a strike; 0.05+ a soft swell).

decay.description: Seconds to fall from full level: to silence (-60 dB) when sustain is 0; otherwise the time to settle to the sustain level.

sustain.description: Level held while the note is held (0–1). 0 = a struck or plucked sound that rings out; above 0 = a sustained sound that holds for the note's `len`.

release.description: Seconds to fade to silence after a held note ends.

anyOf.description: An oscillator following the note's pitch: { "osc": "saw", "level": 0.6 }. Band-limited by the engine.

ratio.description: Frequency as a multiple of the note's. Bars and bells have inharmonic ratios (marimba 1, 3.93, 9.2; glockenspiel 1, 2.76, 5.4, 8.93).

decay.description: Seconds until this partial has faded to silence (-60 dB); notes are cut (with a fade) at 10 s. Higher partials usually die sooner.

modes.description: Damped partials, each ringing out on its own — the model of struck bars, bells, tines and plates.

lowRingsLonger.description: How much longer low notes ring: 0 = the same at every pitch; 1 = twice as long two octaves below middle C (a marimba).

noise.description: white = hiss, pink = softer, rumblier noise.

level.description: Level 0–1, relative to the other blocks.

burst.description: A short burst of this many seconds at the start, smoothly windowed: a mallet click (0.004), a pick or pin (0.002), a breath (0.05).

decay.description: Seconds for the noise to fade to silence (-60 dB) from the onset, instead of a `burst`.

env.description: An envelope instead of `burst` or `decay` (for held noise: wind, breath, a hiss).

attack.description: Seconds to rise to full level (0.001–0.005 a strike; 0.05+ a soft swell).

decay.description: Seconds to fall from full level: to silence (-60 dB) when sustain is 0; otherwise the time to settle to the sustain level.

sustain.description: Level held while the note is held (0–1). 0 = a struck or plucked sound that rings out; above 0 = a sustained sound that holds for the note's `len`.

release.description: Seconds to fade to silence after a held note ends.

cutoff.description: Cutoff (centre for bandpass) in Hz: lowpass 800 is muffled, 4000 soft, 12000 open.

q.description: Resonance: 0.7 neutral, 2–6 a peak at the cutoff (squelchy, vocal), up to 12.

sweep.description: Octaves the cutoff starts away from `cutoff` and glides back over `sweepTime` (4 = starts 4 octaves higher: a bright pluck that closes).

sweepTime.description: Seconds the sweep takes to reach `cutoff`.

at.description: Seconds after the onset that the noise starts.

anyOf.description: Noise for clicks, breath, scrapes, snares and hiss: { "noise": "white", "burst": 0.004, "level": 0.2 }. Give `burst`, `decay` or `env` (default: decay 0.1).

pluck.description: Brightness of the pluck in Hz: 500 a soft finger (nylon), 3000 a pick, 8000 a sharp metal twang.

position.description: Where the string is plucked: 0.5 the middle (round), 0.1 near the bridge (thin, twangy).

damping.description: How fast the highs die: 0 rings bright (steel), 0.65 soft (nylon), 0.9 muted.

ring.description: Seconds to fade to silence at middle C; higher notes ring shorter.

body.description: Low-pass on the output in Hz: 2200 mellow, 8000 open.

string.description: A plucked string (Karplus–Strong). {} is a soft nylon string.

level.description: Level 0–1, relative to the other blocks.

anyOf.description: A plucked string that follows the note's pitch: { "string": { "pluck": 3000, "damping": 0.3, "ring": 3 } }.

attack.description: Seconds to rise to full level (0.001–0.005 a strike; 0.05+ a soft swell).

decay.description: Seconds to fall from full level: to silence (-60 dB) when sustain is 0; otherwise the time to settle to the sustain level.

sustain.description: Level held while the note is held (0–1). 0 = a struck or plucked sound that rings out; above 0 = a sustained sound that holds for the note's `len`.

release.description: Seconds to fade to silence after a held note ends.

env.description: Envelope: how the level moves over the note. Struck sounds: { "attack": 0.002, "decay": 1.5 }. Held sounds: { "attack": 0.02, "decay": 0.3, "sustain": 0.7, "release": 0.3 }.

anyOf.description: The envelope of the whole sound (oscillators and strings follow it unless they have their own).

filter.description: lowpass removes highs (warmer), highpass removes lows (thinner), bandpass keeps a band (telephone, nasal).

cutoff.description: Cutoff (centre for bandpass) in Hz: lowpass 800 is muffled, 4000 soft, 12000 open.

q.description: Resonance: 0.7 neutral, 2–6 a peak at the cutoff (squelchy, vocal), up to 12.

sweep.description: Octaves the cutoff starts away from `cutoff` and glides back over `sweepTime` (4 = starts 4 octaves higher: a bright pluck that closes).

sweepTime.description: Seconds the sweep takes to reach `cutoff`.

anyOf.description: A filter on the whole sound: { "filter": "lowpass", "cutoff": 3000, "q": 0.7, "sweep": 3, "sweepTime": 0.2 }.

from.description: Semitones away from the note's pitch at the onset (24 = two octaves above).

to.description: Semitones away from the note's pitch at the end of the glide (0 = lands on the note).

time.description: Seconds the glide takes. Default: the whole note (for effects with a length, its `len`).

curve.description: exp: fast at first, then settles (kicks, pops, thumps); linear: an even glide in semitones (lasers, sirens, risers).

pitchEnv.description: A pitch glide at the start of every note.

lfo.description: vibrato wobbles the pitch, tremolo the level.

rate.description: Wobbles per second (5–6 is natural; 30+ is a buzz).

depth.description: vibrato: cents up and down (10–30 natural; default 20); tremolo: 0–1, how far the level dips (default 0.25, gentle).

delay.description: Seconds before the wobble starts (it fades in over the same time).

items.description: One block, named by its key: osc, modes, noise, string, env, filter, pitchEnv, lfo. Sound sources (osc, modes, noise, string) are mixed; env, filter, pitchEnv and lfo shape the whole sound.

blocks.description: Sound sources and shapers. At least one source (osc, modes, noise or string).

description.description: One line for people: what this sounds like.

additionalProperties.description: A custom instrument: { "base": … } tweaks a built-in, { "layers": [ … ] } stacks sounds, { "blocks": [ … ] } builds one from blocks.

instruments.description: Custom instruments and effects, by name, used in tracks like built-ins: { "softBell": { "base": "glockenspiel", "params": { "decay": 1.5, "brightness": -0.4 } } }. Data only: the engine keeps every sound clean and at a balanced level.

instrument.description: Which instrument or sound effect plays this track: a built-in, or one defined under "instruments". Built-in: marimba: Wooden bar struck with a soft mallet: warm, round, bouncy. The default for friendly openings, question-and-answer melodies and big chord hits with a low bass. [range C2–C7] | xylophone: Hard wooden bars, bright and dry with a short ring: quick runs, playful and comedic hits, cartoon energy. [range C3–C7] | glockenspiel: Small steel bars: bell-like, sparkling, long ring. Magic, twinkles, a logo shine; doubles a melody an octave up at low gain for sparkle. [range C3–C8] | vibraphone: Metal bars with a shimmering tremolo: smooth, jazzy, calm. Lounge, tech and corporate stings, soft chords. [range C3–C7] | musicbox: Tiny plucked steel comb: delicate, nostalgic, lullaby-like. Sounds an octave above the written pitch. [range C3–C7; sounds an octave above the written pitch] | grandpiano: Recorded grand piano (a Steinway B): the real sound, for anything that should sound like a real piano. Each note rings about 3 s, unless its key is released: a written len releases it (the dampers stop it), the track's pedal keeps released notes ringing until it lifts, and striking the same key again cuts the note still ringing, as on a real piano. Its samples download on first use (about 1.2 MB per note). [range A0–A7; dampers: len releases the key, pedal holds it] | organ: Drawbar organ with a gentle wobble: sustained, churchy or retro-funky. Holds each note for its `len`. [range C2–C7; sustained (holds for len)] | ukulele: Nylon-string ukulele, finger-plucked: soft, warm, short ring. Happy vlog and family-channel tunes, gentle strums. [range C3–C6] | piccolo: Synthetic piccolo/flute: airy, whistling melody line. Sounds an octave above the written pitch. Sounds synthetic, not like a real flute. [range C4–C7; sounds an octave above the written pitch; sustained (holds for len); sounds synthetic] | trumpet: Synthetic trumpet: bright brass fanfare line. Sounds synthetic, not like a real trumpet. [range E3–C6; sustained (holds for len); sounds synthetic] | clap: Hand clap (unpitched). Variants: "studio" (drum-machine clap, the default), "snappy" (tighter, brighter), "hands" (one person, natural), "group" (a few people together). Use `repeat` for claps on every beat. [no pitch; variants studio/snappy/hands/group] | clock: Clock tick-tock (sound effect). Variants "tick" (default) and "tock"; alternate them with "variant": ["tick", "tock"] and `repeat`. [no pitch; variants tick/tock] | footsteps: Footsteps (sound effect): heel, toe and scuff of an ordinary shoe. Variants "left" (default) and "right"; walk with "variant": ["left", "right"] and `repeat` every 0.5–1 beat. Variants "carpet", "concrete", "snow" and "wood" are recorded steps on that surface (one recording each, two for "wood"), e.g. "variant": "wood" with `repeat`. [no pitch; variants left/right/carpet/concrete/snow/wood] | heels: High-heel footsteps (sound effect): a sharp clack and the sole after it. Variants "left" (default) and "right"; walk with "variant": ["left", "right"] and `repeat`. [no pitch; variants left/right] | tapdance: Tap-dance taps (sound effect): a dry crack on a wooden floor. Variants "toe" (default), "heel" (lower, heavier), "shuffle" (a brush and a tap). [no pitch; variants toe/heel/shuffle] | pistol: Pistol shot (sound effect). Variants "shot" (default: crack and boom) and "cartoon" (a light pop-gun). [no pitch; variants shot/cartoon; sounds synthetic] | laser: Laser zap 'pew' (sound effect): a falling electronic sweep. Optional `pitch` sets where it starts (default about D7); `len` sets the sweep's length (default 0.25 s). [range C5–C8 (optional pitch); len default 0.25 s; sounds synthetic] | whoosh: Whoosh (sound effect) for transitions and things flying past. Variants "soft" (default) and "fast". `len` sets its length (default 0.5 s); place it with "end" to finish on a cut. [no pitch; len default 0.5 s; variants soft/fast] | riser: Riser (sound effect): builds up into a hit. Variants "noise" (default) and "tone". Place it by its end: { "end": "hit", "len": 4 } rises for 4 beats and stops exactly on the cue. Default length 2 s. [no pitch; len default 2 s; variants noise/tone; sounds synthetic] | impact: Impact boom (sound effect) for reveals and big landings. Variants "soft" (default) and "hard". Put it on the cue the animation lands on. [no pitch; variants soft/hard] | pop: Pop (sound effect): a short bubbly blip for things appearing or text popping in. Optional `pitch` sets where it starts. [range C4–C7 (optional pitch)] | knock: Knock on wood (sound effect). Variants "door" (default) and "table". "Knock-knock": two notes about half a beat apart, or `repeat`. [no pitch; variants door/table] | glass: Glass clink (recorded sound effect): two glasses touching, a toast, a glass set down. [no pitch] | ding: Struck bell (recorded sound effect): a single "ding" — a hotel desk bell, a correct answer, a reveal. [no pitch] | metal: Light metal clang (recorded sound effect): a pan or a metal object knocked. [no pitch] | punch: Punch or slap (recorded sound effect). Variants "hit" (default: a heavy punch) and "soft" (a soft thud, a fall onto a cushion). [no pitch; variants hit/soft] | book: Book (recorded sound effect). Variants "flip" (default: a page turned) and "place" (a book set down on a table). [no pitch; variants flip/place] | door: Door (recorded sound effect). Variants "close" (default: a door shut, two takes) and "creak" (a slow creaking hinge, about 0.8 s, swelling in). For knocking use "knock". [no pitch; variants close/creak] | dice: Dice (recorded sound effect). Variants "throw" (default: dice thrown onto a table, two takes), "die" (a single die) and "shake" (dice rattled in a hand, 1.5 s). [no pitch; variants throw/die/shake] | cards: Playing cards (recorded sound effect). Variants "place" (default: a card slid and laid down, two takes; the card lands 0.1–0.15 s after the note) and "fan" (a hand of cards fanned out, about 0.7 s). [no pitch; variants place/fan] | cloth: Cloth rustle (recorded sound effect): clothes moving, a coat put on (two takes). [no pitch] | applause: Applause (sound effect generated with Stable Audio 3): a small audience clapping, fading out over about 5 s. [no pitch] | shutter: Camera shutter click (sound effect generated with Stable Audio 3): a photo being taken, about 0.2 s. [no pitch] | coin: Coin dropped on a table (sound effect generated with Stable Audio 3): a bright clink and a short rattle, about 1.9 s. [no pitch] | page: Page turn (sound effect generated with Stable Audio 3): one paper page turned slowly, about 1.6 s; softer and longer than book's "flip". [no pitch] | droplet: Water droplet (sound effect generated with Stable Audio 3): one drop falling into still water, a "plop", about 1.3 s. [no pitch]

name.description: Optional label for people, e.g. "melody" or "bass".

gain.description: Track level in dB (0 = as is, -6 = about half as loud).

reverb.description: false keeps this track out of the reverb (dry, close effects such as clicks and ticks).

sing.description: Sing this track (its notes' kana `lyric`s) with NEUTRINO instead of playing its instrument; one track per score. Whether NEUTRINO and the voice are installed where the score is rendered is known only by asking: checkScore and renderScore of a score with `sing` answer with what is missing, if anything is (nothing falls back to the instrument). Only the browser build cannot sing. The first render of a sung track takes tens of seconds; the same one again is instant.

engine.description: The singing synthesizer: "neutrino". It is set up where the score is rendered (for people: NEUTRINO_DIR in .env, default /Applications/NEUTRINO); renderScore says so if it is missing.

voice.description: A NEUTRINO voice, e.g. "reina" or "merrow" (default REINA).

level.description: Vocal loudness over the other tracks, in LU (≈ dB). Default 4: the voice a little in front. The track's `gain` adds to it.

seconds.description: Seconds from the start of the jingle.

anyOf.description: A time in seconds, for times the animation fixes ("lands at 1.5 s").

at.description: When the note starts: a number of beats from the start (0, 0.5, 1 …); or { "seconds": n }; or a cue name ("hit"); or a cue name with an offset in beats ("hit+1" = one beat after the cue, "hit-0.5" = half a beat before).

end.description: For effects with a length (whoosh, riser, laser): when it ends, instead of `at`. A riser into the hit is { "end": "hit", "len": 4 }.

seconds.description: Seconds from the start of the jingle.

anyOf.description: A time in seconds, for times the animation fixes ("lands at 1.5 s").

pitch.description: A pitch, or a list of pitches for a chord. Required for pitched instruments; leave it out for unpitched ones.

anyOf.description: Scientific pitch notation: "C4" is middle C, "A4" is 440 Hz; sharps "F#3", flats "Bb5".

items.description: Scientific pitch notation: "C4" is middle C, "A4" is 440 Hz; sharps "F#3", flats "Bb5".

chord.description: A chord by name instead of `pitch`: "C", "Am", "G7", "Fmaj7", "Bb", "F#m7", "Dsus4". The instrument voices it: a ukulele plays a real chord shape, other instruments stack it from octave 4. Use `pitch` instead for exact notes.

strum.description: Strum the chord string by string, slightly loose like a real hand. "down" or "up" for one stroke, or a pattern: one character per eighth note, D = down, U = up, d/u = soft, - = rest. "D-DU-UDU" is one 4-beat bar of the classic island strum; combine with `repeat` ({ "every": 4, "count": 2 }) for more bars. A pitch list is strummed in the order written (string order).

grid.description: Beats per pattern character (default 0.5: eighth notes; 0.25 for sixteenths).

vel.description: Velocity 0–1: how hard the note is played (0.8 normal, 1 the big hit, 0.35 a soft echo).

len.description: How long sustained instruments hold, and how long effects with a length (whoosh, riser, laser) last: a number of beats, or { "seconds": n } when the request gives seconds ("builds for 2 seconds" is { "seconds": 2 }). On instruments with dampers (grandpiano) it is how long the key is held: the note stops when it ends, unless the track's `pedal` is down then; leave it out to let the note ring. Other struck and plucked instruments ring out and ignore it.

pan.description: Overrides the track's pan for this note: 0 left, 0.5 centre, 1 right.

variant.description: For sounds with variants (listed per instrument). A list cycles over `repeat`s, e.g. ["left", "right"].

every.description: Beats between repetitions (1 = every beat, 0.5 = every eighth note).

count.description: How many times the note sounds in total, including the first.

until.description: Repeat up to and including this time (any `at` form, e.g. a cue). Give `count` or `until`, not both.

seconds.description: Seconds from the start of the jingle.

anyOf.description: A time in seconds, for times the animation fixes ("lands at 1.5 s").

repeat.description: Play the same note repeatedly, e.g. a clock ticking or claps on every beat. Each repetition is its own note in the timing map.

detune.description: Cents (1/100 semitone) to detune this note by.

humanize.description: Up to this many ms of seeded random timing offset. Never moves a note placed exactly on a cue.

lyric.description: One syllable of the words sung on this note, shown karaoke-style; the instrument plays the melody (a track with `sing` sings it). Write the melody first and give its notes the syllables. One kana or mora per note in Japanese ("ハ", "テ", "ナ"); one syllable in English, ending in "-" when the word continues on the next note ("hap-", "py"). "_" holds the previous syllable over this note. On a track with `sing`, the notes are sung: one kana mora per note (no romaji/English), and a note without a lyric right after a sung note holds its vowel (a rest only when nothing is sounding).

lineEnd.description: true ends a line of lyrics after this note's syllable. The last syllable of a track ends its line anyway.

items.description: One note or chord (or one sound effect hit).

clef.description: Sheet music only: the staff's clef. Leave it out to choose from the pitches ("bass" when they are mostly below A3).

notation.description: Sheet music only: false leaves this track off the sheet music (an accompaniment you do not want shown). Sound effects are never shown.

pedal.description: Sustain pedal, for instruments with dampers (grandpiano): stretches in time order that do not overlap. While it is down, notes whose `len` has ended ring on; when it lifts, they stop. Change pedal where the harmony changes, as the printed Ped. marks show. Notes without `len` ring out regardless. Two tracks of one piano (right and left hand) each need it.

seconds.description: Seconds from the start of the jingle.

anyOf.description: A time in seconds, for times the animation fixes ("lands at 1.5 s").

at.description: When the pedal goes down: beats, { "seconds": n }, or a cue (as a note's `at`).

seconds.description: Seconds from the start of the jingle.

anyOf.description: A time in seconds, for times the animation fixes ("lands at 1.5 s").

until.description: When it lifts, after `at`. To change pedal, start the next span where this one ends.

items.description: One instrument's part. Use several tracks for several instruments, or for melody and bass on the same instrument.

description: A jingle: a short piece of music and sound effects, with named cues an animation can sync to.
